Is a verbal agreement legally binding in New York State?
L
Yes, verbal agreements are generally enforceable in New York under contract law - provided offer, acceptance, and consideration exist. However, under the Statute of Frauds (NY GOL Section 5-701), certain contracts must be in writing: agreements that cannot be performed within one year, real estate transactions, and contracts over $500 for goods. The Product

Your legal team's
unfair advantage

Lexorium is a Legal Intelligence Engine - a conversational AI built from the ground up for legal professionals. It understands statutes, interprets precedents, reviews contracts, and answers complex legal questions across jurisdictions with the authority of a senior counsel and the speed of a machine.

For lawyers, it is a force multiplier. What takes a team of associates three days takes Lexorium three minutes. What requires billing 40 hours for research takes a single conversation. Lexorium doesn't replace lawyers - it makes them extraordinarily more powerful.

For enterprises, it is a competitive moat. Legal risk identified before contracts are signed. Regulatory exposure mapped before entering new markets. Compliance monitored continuously, not quarterly.

Lexorium integrates into your existing workflow - your DMS, your email, your deal rooms - and learns the specific vocabulary, preferences, and risk tolerance of your firm over time. It is not a generic AI chatbot. It is your firm's intelligence, amplified.

Semantic Legal Research
Search statutes, case law, and precedents by meaning. Not keywords - intent. Find the exact authority that wins your case.
Automated Contract Intelligence
Upload any agreement. Lexorium reads, flags risk clauses, benchmarks terms against market standards, and drafts redlines - in minutes.
Multi-Jurisdiction Compliance
Track regulatory obligations across key markets and evolving legal frameworks with greater speed and clarity. Enter new environments with more confidence and better legal visibility.
Predictive Risk Scoring
AI risk assessment trained on millions of legal outcomes. Know your exposure before you sign - or before you litigate.
Legal Drafting Assistant
Draft contracts, briefs, memos, and legal opinions in your firm's voice. From term sheets to Supreme Court briefs.
Private & Confidential
Your privileged communications stay privileged. Zero-retention architecture. No data ever trains external models.
Live Demo

See Lexorium think

Ask it a legal question. Watch it reason. This is what the future of legal work looks like.

Lexorium - Contract Review: Services_Agreement_Acme_v3.pdf
You
Review this agreement for liability exposure and flag any non-standard indemnification clauses under both US and EU law. Identify jurisdiction conflicts.
L
Analysis Complete - 3 Critical Flags
Section 8.2 - Uncapped Liability (HIGH RISK)
Non-standard under US commercial practice. Unlimited exposure. Recommend: mutual cap at 12x monthly fees. Delaware courts will enforce this clause against your client.
Section 12.1 - Unilateral Indemnification (EU NON-COMPLIANT)
One-way indemnity violates EU Directive 2019/770 on B2B digital services. Bilateral clause required. Unenforceable in 22 of 27 EU member states as drafted.
Section 15.4 - Governing Law Conflict (JURISDICTION RISK)
Delaware law designated, but counterparty is an EU entity. Choice-of-law clause likely unenforceable under Rome I Regulation. Recommend neutral arbitration clause.
Ask Lexorium anything about this contract or any legal matter...

About

A company built
on one belief - enterprise AI should feel exceptional.

Sprezzatura AI exists because the most important technology of our era should be delivered with control, discretion, and a world-class user experience.

The Company

Sprezzatura AI

An advanced artificial intelligence company building private, high-performance AI systems for the next generation of global enterprises.

"The most advanced technology should feel invisible to the user - while delivering extraordinary capability behind the scenes. That is effortless mastery. That is Sprezzatura."

Sprezzatura AI was founded on a principle drawn from 16th-century Italian philosophy: sprezzatura - the art of making the extraordinarily difficult appear effortless. It is the mark of true mastery.

Today, that principle guides everything we build. Positioned at the convergence of artificial intelligence, law, and scalable digital operations, we are developing a new class of AI systems that combine speed, clarity, and discretion - systems enterprises can trust, shape, and deploy around their own standards.

Our suite of platforms - beginning with Lexorium, the world's most advanced legal intelligence engine - represents a new architecture for enterprise AI: private by design, powerful by necessity, and effortless by philosophy.

We serve clients across the United States, Europe, and emerging markets - building the operating system for the intelligent enterprise.

Our Long-Term Vision
To become the world's most trusted enterprise AI company - integrating artificial intelligence, legal intelligence, workflow systems, and strategic advisory into one premium ecosystem. The organizations that define the next century will be the ones that operationalize intelligence with discipline and taste. We are building the platform that makes that possible.
